To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
flg22-derived elicitor peptides induce H2O2 release in S. japonica, that flg15 is a sufficient elicitor peptide and that the elicitor activity is dependent on amino acid position D43.
flg15-derived peptide, but not flg22, is the smallest peptide that can induce ROS in S. japonica female gametophyts.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the elicitor activity, the elicitor peptide size and the localization of ROS in S. japonica.
the elicitor activities of flg22- and flg15-derived peptide fragments in the brown algal gametophytes.
the elicitor activity and the elicitation of defense responses in female gamatophytes of S. japonica.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
flg22-derived elicitors are able to activate a ROS burst, which is localized in the plasma membrane of S. japonica female gametophyte cells.
the elicitor activity in S. japonica is mediated by a flg15-derived peptide, which induces H2O2 production by an NAD(P)H oxidase.
flg22-derived peptide elicitors induce ROS production, growth inhibition and defense responses in female gameteophytes of S. japonica.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the N-terminal amino acid position of D43 in flagellin-derived peptides is involved in the elicitation of ROS in S. japonica female gametophyts.
flg15-derived peptide is the smallest peptide of flagellin with elicitor activity in S. japonica, and the N-terminally located amino acid D43 is involved in the elicitation.
the elicitor activities of flg22- and flg15-derived synthetic peptides were observed in female gametophyte of S. japonica, and the elicitor activity depended on the length of peptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
flg22-derived elicitor peptides induce defense responses, which may be involved in the innate immunity of S. japonica.
the flg22-derived peptide flg15 induces H2O2 production and inhibits growth in the female gametophyte of the brown alga S. japonica.
